name: Defensoría del Pueblo
body: Language alternates, HSTS, alt text on every image, and every internal link opened answered. But the home page HTML weighs about 1.2 MB before any image or script, and all 20 pages analyzed top 500 KB.
lesson: Move inline data, styles, and menus out of the HTML. Phones parse every byte first.
summary: www.defensoria.gov.co scores 76 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 23 are at risk, and 18 pass. Fix first: 19 pages name another URL as canonical.

fix.title: 19 pages name another URL as canonical
fix.evidence: /web/guest → /, /web/guest/que-hacemos → /que-hacemos, /web/guest/derechos-humanos → /derechos-humanos, /web/guest/organigrama → /organigrama and 15 more. Search engines will usually index the other URL instead.
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

fix.title: 1 form control has no label
fix.evidence: On /web/guest/resoluciones. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 13 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /web/guest/derechos-humanos, /web/guest/organigrama, /web/guest/directorio-de-dependencias, /web/guest/acreditaci%C3%B3n-de-instituciones-nacionales-de-ddhh and 9 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Universal Analytics code is still on the page
fix.evidence: Google stopped processing Universal Analytics data in July 2024. The code adds weight and collects nothing.
fix.fix: Remove the UA- tag and keep GA4.

fix.title: 47 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Universal Analytics, Google Tag Manager appear in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 493 ms
Language alternates point at each other
